en: A sepia-toned old photograph showing wooden riverside houses in the foreground and, on the hill behind them, the ruins of a large brick castle or fortress wall with a tall, rectangular tower punctuated by several window openings. Snow patches lie on the slope leading up to the ruins, and the river in front appears calm or slightly frozen. The overall scene is rural and wintry, with no visible modern buildings or vehicles.
